items.title: New member onboarding - checking and online banking setup
items.text: Opened new membership today for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0064}}. Contact phone on file is {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0064}}. Home address is {{CLIENT_ADDRESS:c_0064}}, verified against the ID presented. Checking account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00140}} opened with the standard opening deposit. Member enrolled in online banking at the counter from device {{CLIENT_DEVICE:c_0064}}, and MFA was set up without issues. Source of funds is self-employed consulting income. Member mentioned they expect incoming wires from overseas customers, so I walked them through our incoming wire instructions and cutoff times. Friendly, quick visit. No follow-up needed right now.

items.title: Onboarding note - new consulting member, checking opened
items.text: New member visit this afternoon. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0061}} joined and opened checking account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00135}}. Best contact number is {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0061}}. - Originator: Pinecrest Remote Services LLC
- Originator account: {{CP_IBAN:cp_019}}
- Beneficiary: member account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00113}} ({{CLIENT_NAME:c_0050}})
- Rule triggered: large inbound international wire to a newly opened account (opened 2026-08-05)

Assigning to myself for review. Pulling account history from CoreBanking and the onboarding notes in MemberCRM.

--- Comment by Monica Feld ---
Initial review: the full $22,000.00 did not stay put. Funds moved to two other member accounts within hours of the wire posting, via internal transfers initiated through online banking. Stated source of funds at onboarding was self-employed consulting income with expected overseas customer wires, but nothing in the account looks like ordinary business activity, no operating expenses, just in and out. I'm tracing the two receiving accounts now and checking whether they have similar inbound wire activity. Will loop in Chris Burgess once I have the flow mapped. Holding off on any member contact until then.
